instruction: Please shift the text box toward the right side of the canvas to avoid overlapping with elements on the left.

metadata.explanation: Task requires moving the text layer to the right side. Evaluator calculates the text bounding box and verifies that the center x-coordinate is in the right half of the image (>50% width) to ensure text is positioned on the right side and doesn't overlap with left elements. Verified: Text can be repositioned horizontally using GIMP Move tool.

llm_judge_reasons: Correct verification logic: Metric calculates text bounding box (leftmost, rightmost, topmost, bottommost dark pixels) and computes center position as (left_most + right_most) / 2, which correctly represents the text's horizontal center.
Appropriate threshold: Checks if text_center_x > width * 0.5 (right half), which semantically matches 'shift toward the right side to avoid overlapping with elements on the left'.
Complete coverage: Instruction requires text to be positioned on right side to avoid left overlap, and evaluator verifies text center is in right half of canvas.
Correct state extraction: Postconfig exports GIMP canvas to PNG file, allowing pixel-level analysis of text position after the user completes the task.
Edge case handling: Returns 0.0 if no text found (found_text=False) or if file is None.
Minor consideration: A stricter threshold like 60% or 66% could better match 'right side' semantics, but 50% (right half) is reasonable and provides clear success criteria.
